take_homes: Default to one agent. Split only if the sources need different access, language or stance. Useful against vendor claims.
Several agents averaging their views produce mush unless the synthesizer has a decision framework that forces a pick. Handovers are where work gets lost.
The synthesized answer is unverified. Nothing in this module checks that it is true.

monday.move: Nothing new. At most, one single-agent run on a real question from my own wiki, to see whether it is better than what I get today.

misconception.why: This did not sound like the last programmes: it tells me not to use more than I need, it admits the output may be wrong, and the retrieval exercise did something concrete with our own wiki. I still do not know if it holds up on real work, so wait-and-see is not dead, only weaker.

one_line: Better than I expected. They told me what doesn't work, and the retrieval run on our own wiki was real. I still don't know if the answer is right, and neither do they.
